sources.note: Argues that Shannon entropy is the wrong criterion for picking which tokens to train on in RLVR, and selects tokens instead by the Jensen-Shannon divergence of their logit distribution from the group average, updating only the top 10% of these 'unique' tokens.
sources.title: Beyond Entropy: Learning from Token-Level Distributional Deviations for LLM Reasoning

sources.note: TRACED scores a reasoning chain by the geometry of its hidden-state trajectory -- net displacement as progress and curvature as stability -- and uses the two as features for a Gaussian classifier that separates correct from incorrect chains without reading the text.
sources.title: Beyond Scalars: Evaluating and Understanding LLM Reasoning via Geometric Progress and Stability

sources.note: Trains a sparse autoencoder over whole reasoning steps rather than tokens, conditioning both encoder and decoder on the preceding trajectory so the sparse code carries only what the step adds, and shows that step correctness, logicality, length and first token are all linearly decodable from that code.
sources.title: Step-Level Sparse Autoencoder for Reasoning Process Interpretation

result.definition: A 0.5B Qwen2.5 model, used across 3 sources as the smallest rung where a training method's scale trend begins. Its measured position: on a token-selection comparison it runs base 5.65, standard training 10.52 and the proposed method 10.95 on one metric, so absolute scores are low enough that the ordering carries the claim rather than the magnitude. It also appears in step-level sparse-autoencoder work and in trajectory-geometry evaluation.
